0022600150.text: The Sacramento Kings, who are 0-5 and 0-3 on the road, visit the Memphis Grizzlies, who are 5-0, lead the Western Conference, and top the Southwest division, in the Kings' sixth game of the season. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Ty Jerome (back soreness). The Kings trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 123-112 in Sacramento on October 25, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
